msg: Every round shows a pair of gnomes. The gnomes are always shown in the same pairing; a gnome with a green hat is paired with a gnome with an orange hat, a gnome with a small yellow hat is paired with a gnome with a long purple hat, a gnome with a small red hat is paired with a gnome with a long brown hat, a gnome with a pink hat is paired with a gnome with a blue hat. The pairs of gnomes are never altered. I advise using the 'lower risk' rounds where there is (x1) points to be gained to 'test' which gnome of each pair is paying the highest reward. Then try to continue selecting the higher paying gnome going forward. At times it feels like there is a 'switch' between which gnome is paying more. Again, I advise using the (x1) rounds to test that theory when you can - so that you don't miss out on points paying (x5).
